objective: FINANZAS Presupuesto↔CxP GATE 1 V1: auditar exclusivamente mediante SQL canónico de solo lectura las estructuras reales existentes que soportan Presupuestos, ejecución real, comprometido CxP, autorizado, disponible/libre, desviación $/% , utilización, proyección de cierre, comparación contra periodo anterior y drilldown. Determinar linaje exacto, claves de relación, granularidad y reutilización antes de crear o modificar cualquier tabla, vista, endpoint o lógica. No duplicar fuentes de verdad. No DDL, no DML, no LIVE, no Mongo, no frontend financiero autoritativo, no Producción.
acceptance: inventario de tablas/vistas/procedures/functions relacionadas con presupuesto, compras, egresos, pagos, CxP, unidades, periodos y contabilidad
columnas y tipos de los objetos candidatos
PK, unique indexes, índices y FK relevantes
identificar fuente canónica vigente de presupuesto y su granularidad: empresa/unidad/categoría/cuenta/centro/periodo
identificar fuente canónica de real ejecutado y fecha operacional/contable aplicable
identificar fuentes canónicas CxP para saldo, comprometido y autorizado, reutilizando el dominio certificado de Decisión de Pago
identificar relaciones exactas por empresa, unidad, proveedor, cuenta/categoría y periodo
determinar si existe ya presupuesto disponible/libre, desviación, utilización, forecast/proyección y comparación periodo anterior
identificar RBAC existente para presupuestos/finanzas y alcance por unidad
producir matriz REUSE / EXTEND / CREATE / DO_NOT_TOUCH por capacidad
producir lista de gaps físicos y lógicos sin diseñar todavía DDL definitivo
constraints: no crear ni alterar tablas, columnas, vistas, índices, procedures, functions o triggers
no INSERT UPDATE DELETE MERGE TRUNCATE ni EXEC mutante
no hardcodes de empresas, unidades, categorías, cuentas, periodos o reglas financieras
no tocar infraestructura del Universal Worker
frontend no puede convertirse en autoridad de KPIs financieros
preservar el dominio CxP certificado; no crear una fuente paralela de saldo/comprometido/autorizado

queries.name: finance_budget_candidate_objects
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (o.name LIKE '%Presup%' OR o.name LIKE '%Budget%' OR o.name LIKE '%Finanz%' OR o.name LIKE '%CxP%' OR o.name LIKE '%Cuenta%Pagar%' OR o.name LIKE '%Compra%' OR o.name LIKE '%Recepcion%' OR o.name LIKE '%Egreso%' OR o.name LIKE '%Pago%' OR o.name LIKE '%Gasto%' OR o.name LIKE '%Contab%' OR o.name LIKE '%Poliza%' OR o.name LIKE '%Unidad%' OR o.name LIKE '%Empresa%' OR o.name LIKE '%Centro%Costo%' OR o.name LIKE '%Categoria%' OR o.name LIKE '%Cuenta%Cont%' OR o.name LIKE '%Periodo%' OR o.name LIKE '%Forecast%' OR o.name LIKE '%Proyeccion%') ORDER BY s.name,o.type_desc,o.name

queries.name: finance_budget_candidate_columns
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.precision,c.scale,c.is_nullable,c.is_identity,dc.definition AS default_definition FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id LEFT JOIN sys.default_constraints dc ON dc.parent_object_id=t.object_id AND dc.parent_column_id=c.column_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND (t.name LIKE '%Presup%' OR t.name LIKE '%Finanz%' OR t.name LIKE '%CxP%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cuenta%Pagar%' OR t.name LIKE '%Compra%' OR t.name LIKE '%Recepcion%' OR t.name LIKE '%Egreso%' OR t.name LIKE '%Pago%' OR t.name LIKE '%Gasto%' OR t.name LIKE '%Contab%' OR t.name LIKE '%Poliza%' OR t.name LIKE '%Unidad%' OR t.name LIKE '%Empresa%' OR t.name LIKE '%Centro%Costo%' OR t.name LIKE '%Categoria%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cuenta%Cont%' OR t.name LIKE '%Periodo%' OR t.name LIKE '%Forecast%' OR t.name LIKE '%Proyeccion%') ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: finance_budget_indexes
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name,i.name AS index_name,i.is_primary_key,i.is_unique,i.type_desc,c.name AS column_name,ic.key_ordinal,ic.is_included_column FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.indexes i ON i.object_id=t.object_id LEFT JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id LEFT JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND i.is_hypothetical=0 AND (t.name LIKE '%Presup%' OR t.name LIKE '%Finanz%' OR t.name LIKE '%CxP%' OR t.name LIKE '%Compra%' OR t.name LIKE '%Recepcion%' OR t.name LIKE '%Egreso%' OR t.name LIKE '%Pago%' OR t.name LIKE '%Gasto%' OR t.name LIKE '%Contab%' OR t.name LIKE '%Unidad%' OR t.name LIKE '%Empresa%' OR t.name LIKE '%Centro%Costo%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cuenta%Cont%') ORDER BY t.name,i.is_primary_key DESC,i.is_unique DESC,i.name,ic.key_ordinal

queries.name: finance_budget_foreign_keys
queries.sql: SELECT ps.name AS parent_schema,pt.name AS parent_table,pc.name AS parent_column,fk.name AS fk_name,rs.name AS referenced_schema,rt.name AS referenced_table,rc.name AS referenced_column FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id JOIN sys.tables pt ON pt.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id JOIN sys.schemas ps ON ps.schema_id=pt.schema_id JOIN sys.columns pc ON pc.object_id=pt.object_id AND pc.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.tables rt ON rt.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id JOIN sys.schemas rs ON rs.schema_id=rt.schema_id JOIN sys.columns rc ON rc.object_id=rt.object_id AND rc.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE ps.name='dbo' AND (pt.name LIKE '%Presup%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Finanz%' OR pt.name LIKE '%CxP%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Compra%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Recepcion%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Egreso%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Pago%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Gasto%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Contab%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Unidad%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Empresa%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Centro%Costo%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Cuenta%Cont%' OR rt.name LIKE '%Presup%' OR rt.name LIKE '%Unidad%' OR rt.name LIKE '%Empresa%' OR rt.name LIKE '%Proveedor%' OR rt.name LIKE '%Cuenta%Cont%') ORDER BY pt.name,fk.name,pc.name

queries.name: budget_granularity_signals
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND (t.name LIKE '%Presup%' OR t.name LIKE '%Budget%') AND (c.name LIKE '%Empresa%' OR c.name LIKE '%Unidad%' OR c.name LIKE '%Centro%' OR c.name LIKE '%Cuenta%' OR c.name LIKE '%Categoria%' OR c.name LIKE '%Periodo%' OR c.name LIKE '%Mes%' OR c.name LIKE '%Anio%' OR c.name LIKE '%Fecha%' OR c.name LIKE '%Monto%' OR c.name LIKE '%Importe%' OR c.name LIKE '%Presup%') ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: actual_execution_signals
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND (t.name LIKE '%Compra%' OR t.name LIKE '%Recepcion%' OR t.name LIKE '%Egreso%' OR t.name LIKE '%Pago%' OR t.name LIKE '%Gasto%' OR t.name LIKE '%Contab%' OR t.name LIKE '%Poliza%') AND (c.name LIKE '%Empresa%' OR c.name LIKE '%Unidad%' OR c.name LIKE '%Centro%' OR c.name LIKE '%Cuenta%' OR c.name LIKE '%Categoria%' OR c.name LIKE '%Proveedor%' OR c.name LIKE '%Fecha%' OR c.name LIKE '%Periodo%' OR c.name LIKE '%Subtotal%' OR c.name LIKE '%Total%' OR c.name LIKE '%Monto%' OR c.name LIKE '%Importe%' OR c.name LIKE '%Estado%' OR c.name LIKE '%Estatus%') ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: cxp_budget_linkage_signals
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND (t.name LIKE '%CxP%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cuenta%Pagar%' OR t.name='Finanzas_CxP_Sync' OR t.name='Finanzas_CxP_DecisionesPago') AND (c.name LIKE '%Empresa%' OR c.name LIKE '%Unidad%' OR c.name LIKE '%Proveedor%' OR c.name LIKE '%Cuenta%' OR c.name LIKE '%Categoria%' OR c.name LIKE '%Fecha%' OR c.name LIKE '%Periodo%' OR c.name LIKE '%Saldo%' OR c.name LIKE '%Importe%' OR c.name LIKE '%Monto%' OR c.name LIKE '%Decision%' OR c.name LIKE '%Autoriz%') ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: derived_budget_kpi_existing_signals
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (o.name LIKE '%Disponible%' OR o.name LIKE '%Desviacion%' OR o.name LIKE '%Utilizacion%' OR o.name LIKE '%Forecast%' OR o.name LIKE '%Proyeccion%' OR o.name LIKE '%Presupuesto%Real%' OR o.name LIKE '%Comparativo%' OR o.name LIKE '%Variance%') ORDER BY s.name,o.type_desc,o.name

queries.name: finance_rbac_signals
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND (t.name LIKE '%Usuario%' OR t.name LIKE '%Rol%' OR t.name LIKE '%Permiso%' OR t.name LIKE '%Unidad%Usuario%' OR t.name LIKE '%Acceso%') AND (c.name LIKE '%Usuario%' OR c.name LIKE '%Rol%' OR c.name LIKE '%Permiso%' OR c.name LIKE '%Unidad%' OR c.name LIKE '%Empresa%' OR c.name LIKE '%Activo%') ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id
